slots_and_copies.name: slot_0_primary
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: 59 chunks packed from SRAM offset 0x200. Valid iff magic 'Hamtaro\0' matches (FUN_080bdb94 strcmp in FUN_080038c0) and u16 sum at +8 plus complement at +10 validate. Preferred copy; if invalid and backup valid, rebuilt via FUN_08002fd8.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0_backup
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Identical 59 chunks at primary SRAM offsets +0x3E00 (file 0x4000..0x7DC4), byte-identical to primary in cap-01. Selected when primary fails magic/checksum validation; if both copies fail magic, FUN_08002434 creates a new save. No generation counter.

checksums.name: save_chunk_sum16_with_complement
checksums.formula_detail: u16 sum (mod 2^16) of every byte of the 59 descriptor-delimited chunk buffers (desc stride 0x18, table span 0x588, loop bound 0x3B), accumulated per chunk into a u16 then summed; stored LE at struct +8, ones' complement stored LE at struct +10. FUN_08002f84 recomputes from scratch; FUN_08002fd8 delta-adjusts (+8 += ram_chunk_sum - sram_chunk_sum per differing chunk, +10 = ~+8); FUN_080038c0 validates both copies with the pair test (+8 == sum && +10 == ~sum). NOTE: descriptor table is ROM-resident and absent from this workspace, so the covered byte set is a proper subset of the contiguous SRAM span and cannot be recomputed from .sav bytes alone (whole-span sum 0x5442 != stored 0x4D49).

verified_on_samples.computed_hex: 0x5442 (whole contiguous span 0x200..0x3FC4; true 59-chunk subset not recomputable without ROM descriptor table)
n/a (magic absent in both copies; boot code creates a new save)

open_questions: Exact 59-chunk descriptor table (RAM ptr / size / SRAM offset per chunk) is ROM-resident at the unresolved _DAT_08003bf0 address and absent from this workspace; without it the stored sum16 0x4D49 cannot be recomputed from .sav bytes (whole-span sum is 0x5442). Dumping that table closes checksum verification mechanically.
Absolute EWRAM/IWRAM addresses of the canonical save struct, its mirror, and every chunk buffer are unknown (all _DAT_* placeholders unresolved); ram_addr is therefore null for every field.
FUN_080bbc7c chunk-transfer stub body is unrecovered: DMA3 vs CPU copy, transfer width, and exact argument order/direction per call site remain CONFIRMED_STATIC at best.

Semantics of the +0xCF/+0xD0/+0xD1 carry-chain counters (date/time/season vs abstract progress), the +0xCC selection byte (character vs slot vs language), the +0x0C word (=4), and the tail records at 0x3DA5 are hypotheses from code shape and observed values only.
Global header block (0x0000..0x014C) has no mapped gameplay field; its +0x100/+0x140/+0x144/+0x148 sub-fields only feed a diagnostic print path in traced code.
No paired .ss save states exist in this workspace (states/ is empty), so every fuzzing prediction is unverified against live reload behaviour.
